title: Cuba seludup syabu ke Kelantan, polis Thailand rampas syabu RM2.5 juta di Sungai Golok
summary: Kota Bharu: Pasukan keselamatan Thailand merampas 50 kilogram (kg) syabu bernilai kira-kira RM2.5 juta yang dipercayai cuba diseludup masuk ke Malaysia melalui Kelantan dalam operasi di Tak Bai, bertentangan Pengkalan Kubor, Tumpat, Sabtu lalu.

title_en: Attempt to smuggle cocaine into Kelantan, Thai police seize RM2.5 million in Sungai Golok
summary_en: Kota Bharu: Thai security forces seized 50 kilograms (kg) of marijuana worth around RM2.5 million that was believed to be being smuggled into Malaysia via Kelantan in an operation at Tak Bai, opposite Pengkalan Kubor, Tumpat last Saturday.

title: Bana mayor wounded in Pattani ambush
summary: The mayor of Bana town municipality in Pattani was seriously wounded when unidentified gunmen shot him outside his home in Muang district on Thursday night.
